description: Condition operators, one statement { effect: allow, actions: [a:b], resources: [r/1], conditions: { [operator]: { key: expected } } } evaluated against a context holding `key` (or not). Missing or wrongly typed values never satisfy a condition, negated ones included; negated operators need every value to differ, ArrayContainsAll every value present, the others any value. Output is evaluatePolicy's decision.

cases.name: conditional deny applies only when it holds
